_why: Three families, one each: Writer A on Llama 4 Maverick (Gemini dropped 2026-10-17 by the showrunner), Writer B on a top OpenAI model, the First Reader on Opus. The audition is a real contrast and the reader is a stranger to both writers. Maverick writes at most 16,384 tokens a reply.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
